releaseNotes: New: a short welcome on the first launch, explaining that your records live in a Google Sheet in your own Drive, that the sheet is also your backup, and why the app asks for your balances before anything else
The same explanation is in Settings under About, as "How this works", so it is not gone the moment it is dismissed
Everything in 3.8.4 is included - see that release for the thirteen fixes it carried
Installs over the top of 3.6.0 or later
